query:
SELECT
                EXISTS (
                    SELECT
                        1
                    FROM
                        "RolesOnUsers" ru
                        JOIN "RolesOnPermissions" rp ON rp."roleId" = ru."roleId"
                    WHERE
                        ru."userId" = $1
                        AND rp."permissionId" = 'read:professional_features') AS "professional!",
                (
                    SELECT
                        count(*)
                    FROM
                        email_links l
                    WHERE
                        l.macro_id = $1
                        OR EXISTS (
                            SELECT
                                1
                            FROM
                                macro_user_links u
                            WHERE
                                u.link_id = l.id
                                AND u.primary_macro_id = $1)) AS "inboxes!"
